mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cats WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND representative_embedding IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.id AS cat_id, c.name, c.photo_url, COUNT(s.id) AS sighting_count, 1 - (c.representative_embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector)) AS raw_similarity FROM cats c LEFT JOIN sightings s ON s.cat_id = c.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.representative_embedding IS NOT NULL AND 1 - (c.representative_embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector)) >= #{minimumSimilarity} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.photo_url, c.representative_embedding ORDER BY c.representative_embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector), c.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT tag FROM cat_tags WHERE cat_id = #{catId} ORDER BY id
